title: test_normalize_tags fails intermittently in CI
body: tests/test_tags.py::test_normalize_tags passes locally but fails on roughly a third of CI runs with a list order mismatch: ['bug', 'ui', 'api'] != ['api', 'bug', 'ui']. Re-running the job usually makes it green. This is blocking merges.

title: Flaky: test_backoff_is_increasing sometimes fails
body: tests/test_retry.py::test_backoff_is_increasing is nondeterministic. It fails maybe 1 in 4 runs with an assertion that the delays are not strictly increasing. Looks random.

title: test_admin_scopes randomly failing on CI
body: tests/test_auth.py::test_admin_scopes fails intermittently: the scopes come back in a different order on some runs. Passes on retry.

title: normalize_tags test flaky again
body: Seeing test_normalize_tags fail sporadically on CI with the tags in a different order. Passes on re-run.

title: end_of_month returns the wrong day
body: end_of_month(2024, 1) returns 2024-01-30 instead of 2024-01-31. Off-by-one bug in tagkit/dates.py.
